title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight — Episode8 What I Want To Do

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Episode: Episode8 — What I Want To Do
meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
How does your foot feel?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, much better.
It's been hurting considerably less since you treated it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start applying some gauze to those scrapes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Still, there are quite a few.
What caused this exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, we were testing the ejection device that we'll be using during our show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's a device that lets the user jump up really high!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But a strong gust blew while Rui was testing it and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I ended up getting injured as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I guess putting on a show is no simple matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they have their challenges.
Moving around large props is hard, physical work, and it becomes necessary to make adjustments to our various gadgets when the weather turns for the worse.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Getting to do shows with everyone's the best! It's hard sometimes, but I wake up every day looking forward to working on them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Especially the ones Rui comes up with! They're always, fun, exciting and super wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being able to put on the shows that I want to has made me very happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But that's really wonderful.
It's like you and Kamishiro are pouring everything you have into what you truly want to do, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nothing in my life makes me feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why...? Because...
It's true, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Looking at the people around me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We worked very hard to make sure we're able to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We want to go pro together, so we're doing everything we can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's nothing that I actually want to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is just my hunch, but I got the sense that there is something that you want to do, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
I really don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It could be that you just haven't realized it yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, when I was little, I also didn't know what I wanted to do or become.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or rather, I knew what I wanted to do, but had no way of fully appreciating what I was saying...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At first, I thought I'd be happy as long as I was able to make the shows I wanted. Even if I had to do it alone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I realized later that I was really looking for others to do my shows with... Those who felt the same way as me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't able to realize that because I'd given up on that hope. I'd convinced myself that no one else would want to work with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I met the others, was asked how I truly felt and was able to identify my real beliefs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was when it dawned on me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Understanding how you truly feel is much more difficult than you would expect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I thought you were going through the same dilemma, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to give you my life's story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you for treating me.
Our show should turn out just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But please refrain from doing anything too strenuous. That may cause the pain to come back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I promise to be careful...
Oh, since we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahina, why don't you come see our show? Mizuki and the others will also be watching.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I guarantee that it's going to be like nothing you've ever seen before. Also, it's going to have something to do with what we discussed just now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, you may find it more relatable compared to other people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina, I really hope you'll come and watch! It'll put such a big smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I promise to do everything I can to put one on yours!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I know we're asking quite a bit of you, but please stop by if you like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway, if you'll excuse us.
Again, thank you very much for treating me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Understanding how you truly feel is much more difficult than you would expect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I thought you were going through the same dilemma, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do I want to do...?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, let's check out the stage. It says they're amateurs, but I know they're really good!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm only supposed to work until 5:00 pm, so...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui! Emu! Where are you?!
Say something!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do we do...? What if something happened to them...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akito! Have you seen Rui and Emu?!
They were supposed to be testing one of our devices but can't seem to find them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He said he's at the first aid tent...
Shouldn't we go over and see how he's doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we shouldn't just be standing around! We should go to him at once and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kamishiro told me to tell you guys that he'll be here soon and there's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He also said that he should be able to play his part just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that could just be him acting tough...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kamishiro was making adjustments until the last minute to ensure that your show went well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, shouldn't you do him the honor of being patient and waiting for him?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He's right...
We wouldn't be able to do much even if we were to go over to the first aid tent.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And Emu's with him, so let's just be patient and believe in them for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay...
I apologize for losing my cool there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Nene!
Let's regroup and go over our show one last time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, I need to head back.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you guys' show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Likewise! Also, Akito, before you go...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for helping Rui and taking him to the first aid tent!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thank you for calming us down. That actually helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're welcome. To be fair, I really didn't do anything special. Anyway, later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (They were somewhere over there when Mizuki came to talk to me...)

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Alright, here comes the last of our general participants! They're the new hitmakers of street music! Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I'm sure you're tired from volunteering.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad you made it in time! Li'l Bro and his team are about to take the stage!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we only saw him perform with his partner during the Summer Festival. I wonder what they're like as a full unit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
This is it.
And the audience sounds really excited.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's match their energy and... No, we gotta bring even more!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(He hasn't returned yet.
There isn't much time left...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, you must've heard from Shinonome. Yes, I received some treatment and feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm not allowed to do anything too strenuous, so would you mind if I made some changes to how I'm supposed to move?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've already thought about how to reduce your movement to a minimum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you for what you did earlier.
I'll be looking forward to seeing your team's performance now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, did something happen to you and Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Get ready, Kamishiro!
We're gonna blow the roof off this place!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
Get ready to give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're Vivid BAD SQUAD!
How are you all doing?! Are you guys having fun?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna put the pedal to the metal! So hang on tight!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've never seen Kohane sing with her team before until now, but she's incredible... I can't believe how well she's projecting her voice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, Toya seems like a totally different person too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-This is so cool!!
Kohane!! An!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So much power! The air's turning electric...! Akito's improved since the Summer Festival too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They have the entire place eating out of their hands.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Based on how they're performing, they must've practiced more than anyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
They probably pushed themselves quite a bit to get to this point.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Their singing's so loud...
My ears kind of hurt.)
